title: Automated Parts Catalog
description: Combines vehicle fitment and cross-reference data into a structured aftermarket catalog, with repeatable SQL workflows for Buyers Guide and Master Cross outputs.
imageAlt: Illustration of ACES and PIES data feeding a SQL-backed parts catalog

title: Unified Business Reporting
description: Connects sales, purchasing, inventory, and financial data in one Power BI semantic model, creating a shared foundation for business reporting and analysis.
imageAlt: Project illustration for a unified Power BI semantic model

title: Vendor Cost Comparison
description: Consolidates vendor quote histories and calculates landed costs, helping purchasing teams compare suppliers using consistent, up-to-date pricing information.
imageAlt: Project illustration for SQL purchasing and vendor cost analysis

title: SKU Demand Forecasting
description: Builds and compares monthly demand forecasts for 12,000+ automotive parts using ARIMA and Prophet, supporting procurement and inventory planning.
imageAlt: Project illustration for automotive parts demand forecasting with Python

title: Inventory Reconciliation
description: Reconciles accounting and warehouse inventory records to identify discrepancies and analyze their financial impact.
imageAlt: Project illustration for inventory reconciliation and financial analysis

title: Sales & Market Benchmarking
description: Benchmarks internal parts sales against regional market demand to reveal performance gaps, catalog coverage, and potential growth opportunities.
imageAlt: Project illustration for regional automotive sales benchmarking

title: Pricing & Margin Analysis
description: Combines regression analysis and competitor benchmarking to inform wholesale pricing across thousands of SKUs while considering profit margins.
imageAlt: Project illustration for automotive parts pricing analysis

title: Inventory Devaluation
description: Quantifies the impact of price reductions on customer inventory and compares the resulting devaluation with company sales data.
imageAlt: Project illustration for inventory devaluation analysis

title: Parts Cross-Reference System
description: Restructures part-number cross-references into a consistent master dataset to support quote requests, lookups, and ongoing catalog maintenance.
imageAlt: Project illustration for a master automotive part-number cross-reference system
